assets.name: hero-optical-layers-v1
assets.method: Built-in image_gen generation; original concept, no image reference
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original high-end website hero material background, very wide landscape 2:1. Concept: THE OPTICAL LAYER. A close-up architectural material composition of three oversized, ultra-thin translucent optical plates overlapping at a shallow angle, with clean straight planar edges and large softly rounded rectangular corners. The plates extend far beyond the image crop; this is an immersive abstract material study, not a small floating object or a row of cards. The lower third contains the overlapping layers: one satin-frosted pearl plane, one almost-clear glass plane, and a subtle smoked-periwinkle plane beneath. Their aligned but offset edges create precise seams, tiny contact shadows, spatial depth, and a few razor-fine cobalt/violet/champagne refractive highlights. One gently rounded structural corner creates a distinctive open aperture near the lower right; a broad diagonal glass edge enters from the lower left. Mostly matte and softly translucent, very restrained gloss. A warm ivory field (#f8f7f3) fills the upper 60% and central headline region, completely clear and quiet; material softly disappears into that field while its lower edges remain beautifully precise. Controlled asymmetry and ample negative space. Photoreal studio macro material render, finely etched optical surfaces, exceptionally refined lighting, sparse and architectural, graphic art direction for an innovative agent framework. Palette: ivory, pearl, pale graphite, muted periwinkle, tiny cobalt edge accents. The interesting shapes are rigid overlapping planes and rounded apertures, not flowing lines. No waves, no fabric, no silk, no filaments, no dunes, no folds, no ribbons, no liquid, no blobs, no chrome tubes, no rings, no mountains, no circuit boards, no grids, no dots, no glowing beams, no neon border, no generic gradient wallpaper. No icons, no text, no letters, no logo, no website UI, no watermark. Full bleed, no border. Texture and precision material detail must remain visible, but the overall image is light and calm.
